title: 'For CEOs and founders who have hit the wall which cannot be surmounted by good intentions and hard-work alone, this book is an important lesson in structures and gravities'
summary: A Goodreads reviewer calls it required reading for anyone who cares about company building, and frames the audience precisely: founders who have already discovered that effort and intent are not enough against the structures that kill good companies.
blockquote: For CEOs and founders who have hit the wall which cannot be surmounted by good intentions and hard-work alone, this book is an important lesson in structures and gravities that will inevitably show up to kill good companies.
